ucs.title: [LLM] REvil (PINCHY SPIDER) Kaseya VSA supply-chain loader: AgentMon → Defender-disable PS → certutil/cert.exe decode agent.crt
ucs.description: Hunts the exact loader chain REvil/Sodinokibi (CrowdStrike: PINCHY SPIDER; Secureworks: GOLD SOUTHFIELD) used during the July 2021 Kaseya VSA supply-chain attack: the legitimate Kaseya agent (AgentMon.exe) spawning cmd.exe to disable Defender via Set-MpPreference, then renaming certutil.exe to cert.exe and decoding the dropped agent.crt into the Sodinokibi payload. The combined predicate (Kaseya parent + DisableRealtimeMonitoring + agent.crt + cert.exe) is uniquely REvil — no other actor reused this exact toolchain post-Kaseya.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="agentmon.exe" OR Processes.parent_process="*\\Kaseya\\*") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*" Processes.process="*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" Processes.process="*DisableIOAVProtection*") OR (Processes.process="*certutil*" Processes.process="*-decode*" Processes.process="*agent.crt*") OR (Processes.process_name="cert.exe" Processes.process="*-decode*") OR (Processes.process="*copy /Y*" Processes.process="*certutil*" Processes.process="*cert.exe*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// REvil Kaseya VSA loader chain — AgentMon parent + Defender-disable + cert.exe rename + agent.crt decode
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let KaseyaParented = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "agentmon.exe"
         or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has @"\Kaseya\"
         or InitiatingProcessParentFileName =~ "agentmon.exe"
    | extend Stage = "kaseya_parent";
let DefenderDisable = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_all ("Set-MpPreference","DisableRealtimeMonitoring")
       and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("DisableIOAVProtection","DisableScriptScanning","MAPSReporting Disabled")
    | extend Stage = "defender_disable";
let CertutilDecode = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("-decode","agent.crt"))
         or (FileName =~ "cert.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "-decode")
         or (ProcessCommandLine has_all (@"copy /Y","certutil.exe","cert.exe"))
    | extend Stage = "certutil_decode";
union KaseyaParented, DefenderDisable, CertutilDecode
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize StageHits = dcount(Stage),
            Stages = make_set(Stage),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            Commands  = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 16),
            Parents   = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 8)
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| where StageHits >= 2     // any 2 of {kaseya_parent, defender_disable, certutil_decode} on same host = high-fidelity
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// REvil Kaseya VSA loader chain on Sentinel telemetry (Security 4688)
let LookbackDays = 30d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Stage = case(
    (ParentProcessName endswith "\\agentmon.exe" or ParentProcessName contains "\\Kaseya\\"), "kaseya_parent",
    (NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("Set-MpPreference","DisableRealtimeMonitoring") and CommandLine has_any ("DisableIOAVProtection","DisableScriptScanning","MAPSReporting Disabled")), "defender_disable",
    (CommandLine has_all ("-decode","agent.crt")), "certutil_decode",
    (NewProcessName endswith "\\cert.exe" and CommandLine has "-decode"), "certutil_decode",
    (CommandLine has_all ("copy /Y","certutil.exe","cert.exe")), "certutil_decode",
    "none")
| where Stage != "none"
| summarize StageHits = dcount(Stage),
            Stages   = make_set(Stage),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            Commands  = make_set(CommandLine, 16),
            Parents   = make_set(ParentProcessName, 8)
            by Computer, Account
| where StageHits >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: REvil/Sodinokibi Kaseya Loader - Defender Disabling PowerShell Command
id: 7c4b8f12-9d6e-4a3b-8c1f-3a2e9f5b4d11
status: experimental
description: Detects the signature PowerShell Set-MpPreference invocation REvil/Sodinokibi (PINCHY SPIDER) executed via the Kaseya VSA AgentMon.exe process during the July 2021 supply-chain attack to disable Defender prior to dropping and decoding agent.crt.
references:
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/sodinokibi-revil-kaseya-vsa-cyberattack/
  - https://www.huntress.com/blog/rapid-response-kaseya-vsa-mass-msp-ransomware-incident
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.g0115
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_ps:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'Set-MpPreference'
      - 'DisableRealtimeMonitoring'
      - 'DisableIOAVProtection'
  selection_kaseya_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\AgentMon.exe'
  condition: selection_ps and selection_kaseya_parent
falsepositives:
  - Kaseya administrators legitimately scripting Defender configuration via VSA (rare; verify with change record)
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@ParentImage:(*\\AgentMon.exe OR *\\agentmon.exe OR *\\Kaseya\\*) OR @ParentProcessName:(*\\AgentMon.exe OR *\\agentmon.exe)) AND ((@CommandLine:(*Set-MpPreference* OR *set-mppreference*) AND @CommandLine:(*DisableRealtimeMonitoring* OR *disablerealtimemonitoring*)) OR @CommandLine:(*agent.crt* OR *AGENT.CRT*) OR (@CommandLine:(*-decode* OR *-DECODE*) AND @Image:(*\\cert.exe OR *\\CERT.EXE)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ParentBaseFileName=/agentmon\.exe$/i OR ParentImageFileName=/\\Kaseya\\/i OR regex("set-mppreference", field=CommandLine) OR regex("agent\\.crt", field=CommandLine) OR (ImageFileName=/\\cert\.exe$/i AND regex("-decode", field=CommandLine)))
| stage := if(ParentBaseFileName=/agentmon\.eapro$/i, "kaseya_parent", if(regex("set-mppreference", field=CommandLine) AND regex("disablerealtimemonitoring", field=CommandLine), "defender_disable", if(regex("agent\\.crt", field=CommandLine) OR (ImageFileName=/\\cert\.exe$/i AND regex("-decode", field=CommandLine)), "certutil_decode", "none")))
| stage != "none"
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(field=stage, distinct=true, as=stage_count), collect([stage, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName])])
| stage_count >= 2
ucs.rationale: The Kaseya VSA loader chain is REvil's defining 2021 operation: only REvil (PINCHY SPIDER / GOLD SOUTHFIELD) shipped Sodinokibi through trusted MSP RMM software (AgentMon.exe) with the specific combination of (a) Defender-disable Set-MpPreference one-liner, (b) certutil renamed to cert.exe, and (c) base64-encoded payload named agent.crt dropped in C:\kworking\. ucs.title: [LLM] REvil pre-encryption recovery inhibition multi-tool cascade (vssadmin + wmic + bcdedit + wbadmin)
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical REvil/Sodinokibi pre-encryption recovery-destruction script that fires within seconds before T1486: the malware enumerates and runs vssadmin Delete Shadows, wmic shadowcopy delete, bcdedit /set recoveryenabled No + bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures, and wbadmin delete catalog from the same host in tight succession. REvil's leaked builder source confirms all four utilities are invoked back-to-back — detecting ≥2 distinct techniques from one host inside a 10-minute window is the highest-fidelity 'about to encrypt' indicator we get on this actor.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" Processes.process="*delete*" Processes.process="*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" Processes.process="*delete*" Processes.process="*catalog*")) by host Processes.user Processes.process_name _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime dc(process_name) as TechniqueCount values(process_name) as techniques values(commands) as commands values(parents) as parents by host user | where TechniqueCount >= 2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// REvil pre-encryption recovery-destruction cascade — alert when ≥2 distinct recovery-killers fire on one host within 10m
let WindowSize = 10m;
let LookbackHours = 24h;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Technique = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"), "vss_delete",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"), "wmic_shadow_delete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and ProcessCommandLine has "no", "bcdedit_recovery_off",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures"), "bcdedit_bootstatus",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"), "wbadmin_catalog_delete",
    "none")
| where Technique != "none"
| summarize TechniqueCount = dcount(Technique),
            Techniques    = make_set(Technique),
            Commands      = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 16),
            Parents       = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 8),
            FirstSeen     = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen      = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowSize)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2     // empirical: REvil hits 3-4; benign admin = 1 technique only
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DeviceName, AccountName, TechniqueCount, Techniques, Parents, Commands
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// REvil recovery-destruction cascade on Sentinel SecurityEvent (4688)
let WindowSize = 10m;
let LookbackHours = 24h;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Technique = case(
    NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"), "vss_delete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"), "wmic_shadow_delete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and CommandLine has "no", "bcdedit_recovery_off",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures"), "bcdedit_bootstatus",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"), "wbadmin_catalog_delete",
    "none")
| where Technique != "none"
| summarize TechniqueCount = dcount(Technique),
            Techniques    = make_set(Technique),
            Commands      = make_set(CommandLine, 16),
            Parents       = make_set(ParentProcessName, 8),
            FirstSeen     = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen      = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, Account, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowSize)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, Computer, Account, TechniqueCount, Techniques, Parents, Commands
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete* OR *DELETE*) AND @CommandLine:(*shadows* OR *Shadows* OR *SHADOWS*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* OR *ShadowCopy* OR *SHADOWCOPY*) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete* OR *DELETE*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled* OR *RecoveryEnabled* OR *bootstatuspolicy* OR *BootStatusPolicy*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete* OR *DELETE*) AND @CommandLine:(*catalog* OR *Catalog* OR *CATALOG*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (regex("vssadmin.*delete.*shadows", field=CommandLine) OR regex("wmic.*shadowcopy.*delete", field=CommandLine) OR regex("bcdedit.*(recoveryenabled|bootstatuspolicy)", field=CommandLine) OR regex("wbadmin.*delete.*catalog", field=CommandLine))
| technique := if(regex("vssadmin", field=CommandLine), "vss_delete", if(regex("wmic.*shadowcopy", field=CommandLine), "wmic_shadow_delete", if(regex("bcdedit", field=CommandLine), "bcdedit_recovery_off", if(regex("wbadmin", field=CommandLine), "wbadmin_catalog_delete", "none"))))
| technique != "none"
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(field=technique, distinct=true, as=tcount), collect([technique, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])])
| tcount >= 2
ucs.rationale: REvil's leaked builder + reversed binaries (Sodinokibi v2.x) show the actor running all four recovery-inhibition tools in a single embedded shell script before T1486 encryption fires — this fan-out across multiple LOLBins inside seconds is the actor's behavioural fingerprint. Single-tool hits (e.g. just vssadmin) are common from backup admins, but the 2+ distinct LOLBins from a non-machine account
